name: Dakota at Home (South Dakota Aging and Disability Resource Center)
organization: Dakota at Home (South Dakota Aging and Disability Resource Center)
description: Dakota at Home, South Dakota’s Aging and Disability Resource Center: free information, referral and intake for help at home, meals, caregiver support, assisted living and other long-term services for adults 60 and older and adults with disabilities. South Dakota has no Area Agencies on Aging; this statewide line is the local starting point.
next_step: Call and describe what is hard right now. Ask for information and assistance. Press 1 for Long Term Services and Supports. Lines are open 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central Time, Monday to Friday. Military service is not required.
constraints: Many services focus on people age 60 and older and adults with disabilities; eligibility and waitlists vary by program.
Statewide; 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central Time, Monday to Friday.

source_evidence.title: Dakota at Home: Long Term Services and Supports, South Dakota Department of Human Services
source_evidence.scope: Dakota at Home, 833-663-9673: information, intake and referral for Long Term Services and Supports, with elder abuse and ombudsman reports during business hours; read in full. Last updated September 15, 2026. South Dakota has no Area Agencies on Aging; the state division performs that role (ADvancing States state profile, April 2021: https://advancingstates.org/sites/nasuad/files/u34008/South%20Dakota%20State%20Profile%20April%202021.pdf).

name: South Dakota Long Term Care Ombudsman Program
organization: South Dakota Long Term Care Ombudsman Program
description: The regional long-term care ombudsman for this county: advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and residential care facilities.
next_step: Call the regional ombudsman program. Give the facility name and county. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.
Regional ombudsmen work for the state Division of Long Term Services and Supports.
